description: `WidgetDeclaration` proto in `packages/proto/schemas/ui-health/v1/contracts/widget.proto` is fully defined with field semantics documented; a per-framework JSDoc tag (`@vrooliWidget` block) lets components opt in to being embedded as a chat widget. No consumer ships in v1; agent-inbox unified retrieval is the eventual consumer. Documented in this PRD as a deliverable so it survives in the requirements registry.

requirements.description: A `WidgetDeclaration` protobuf message must be defined in `packages/proto/schemas/ui-health/v1/contracts/widget.proto`. All fields must have documented semantics. A per-framework JSDoc tag (`@vrooliWidget` block) must be defined to allow React components to opt in to being embedded as a chat widget. The proto and JSDoc tag are a forward-looking contract; no runtime consumer ships in v1. The definition must be recorded in the requirements registry as a deliverable.
requirements.title: WidgetDeclaration Proto Contract Definition

validation.notes: Proto file compiles without errors using protoc
Every field in WidgetDeclaration has a comment documenting its semantics
`@vrooliWidget` JSDoc tag is parseable by the JSDoc parser used in the provenance pipeline
A React component annotated with `@vrooliWidget` is correctly identified as a widget candidate during scanning
Parse a React component file containing a `@vrooliWidget` JSDoc block and confirm WidgetDeclaration proto fields are populated
Confirm the proto definition is present in the proto registry and accessible to other packages
The WidgetDeclaration contract is registered and versioned so future consumers (e.g., agent-inbox) can implement retrieval without a breaking change
No v1 runtime consumer is required; existence of proto and JSDoc standard satisfies the deliverable

title: WidgetDeclaration contract defined
